name: Create an editorial forest cover with low-positioned copy
query: Create an editorial full-bleed forest cover pattern with a background image, a large left-aligned title near the top, and a short italic description anchored low on the left.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route to wp-patterns and gather target theme, text domain, image asset, title, slug, and categories
Step 2: Create a filesystem pattern with required headers and realistic keywords
Step 3: Use a full-width Cover block with image and dim overlay suitable for readable text
Step 4: Use asymmetric vertical spacing so the title and description occupy distinct visual zones
Step 5: Use italic supporting copy without relying on skipped heading levels or vague placeholder text
Step 6: Escape and translate all visible strings
Step 7: Verify contrast, mobile stacking, and editor parsing
success_criteria: Full-bleed Cover block has a readable overlay and left-aligned composition
Title and description are spatially separated rather than stacked in a generic centered hero
Supporting copy is short, realistic, and styled as a secondary editorial voice
Heading level is accessible and sequential
Image alt handling is intentional: decorative background or descriptive alt as appropriate
No scripts, inline style tags, custom CSS classes, or runtime PHP
Verification covers contrast and responsive layout
